label: Higher education, research, and commercialization estate
domain: universities, laboratories, federal research awards, trustees, technology transfer, spinouts, licenses, and sponsored research
scope: Universities, affiliated laboratories, research centers, principal investigators, federal grants, sponsored research, technology-transfer offices, patents and assignments, licenses, spinouts, trustees, and corporate research partnerships. The estate separates research funding, invention, assignment, license, incorporation, investment, and procurement.

asset_refs.role: bounded frontier survey and acquisition preparation

boundary: A grant, publication, patent, license, spinout, investment, and government contract are different events. Sequence or institutional affiliation does not establish transfer or control.

next_acquisition.operation: join federal research awards to investigators, institutions, inventions, assignments, licenses, spinouts, and later public contracts
next_acquisition.decisive_output: award-to-commercialization chain with exact grant, investigator, institution, patent, assignment, license, company, funding, and contract identifiers
